DSI: sum of raw aligned PD mean trace minus sum of raw aligned ND mean trace

DSI_peak.baseline: existing effective GT baseline (gt_affine_from_pack after forward_pack)
DSI_peak.aggregation: align each entry to first stimulus, subtract per-entry baseline, average each direction, take nonnegative peak in its common window
